requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.quote: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

requirements.quote: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s)

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear a marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear a marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the specific identification code of the light source module(s) shall be followed by additional symbols or characters, in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
requirements.quote: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters;

requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (ii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which it may be subjected in such use, its satisfactory operation remains assured and it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the functions shall be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), except that they may be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps. In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The lamp (function) shall not incorporate a manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface, except that on request of the applicant it may incorporate only one manufacturer logo provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled, the logo is only the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer, and the size of the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions: (a) Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed. This shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)). (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: A group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.quote: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded;

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
requirements.quote: (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (a) A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1; Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (b) A rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1; Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (c) A stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1; Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (d) A stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3; Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (e) A direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a; Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (f) A rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1. Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.quote: and (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.quote: and (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s)

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall have its intensities measured with the light source continuously lit, if not otherwise specified.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.

requirements.text: In the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.

requirements.text: This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems), unless otherwise specified.
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: The test laboratory may require the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: 4.8.2.2.1. in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.quote: 4.8.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.quote: or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., on the reference axis (HV).
requirements.quote: (a) On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall not exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., in no direction where the lamp is visible.
requirements.quote: (b) In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, outside the reference axis, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: (c) Outside the reference axis, - be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, outside the reference axis, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: - be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (d) Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: In order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the applicant may request an additional test.
requirements.quote: the applicant may request an additional test,

requirements.text: In order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the additional test shall show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5×10-1cd.
requirements.quote: to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5×10-1cd.

requirements.text: In order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
requirements.quote: This additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.quote: the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.

requirements.text: If the one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.quote: the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation;

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.quote: Colour of light emitted The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.

requirements.text: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit light of red colour.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.quote: Luminous intensity and standard light distribution: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.

requirements.quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit light of the colour red.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.quote: Luminous intensity and standard light distribution: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.

requirements.text: When the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5×10¹ cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5×10¹ cd shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: The condition regarding installation exclusively in a pair of devices shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents.
requirements.quote: This condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).

requirements.text: When the type approval will be granted applying the condition above, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.quote: Moreover, in the case where the type approval will be granted applying the condition above, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit light of the colour white.

requirements.quote: 3.3.4.2.2. in case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F an orientation mark "TOP" on any marking material whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational.

requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4 shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall not be rough.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough

requirements.text: Any protuberances on the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflective device when in normal use.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

requirements.text: When testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1=β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1 shall be used.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1=β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1 shall be used.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: ... (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; ...

requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: ... (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: ...The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.quote: ...Four samples out of the remaining eight samples shall be selected at random and divided into two groups of two in each group.

requirements.quote: ...The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: ...Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.quote: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.quote: Sample evaluation Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective areas shall have a coefficient of retro-reflection RA, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', which shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

requirements.text: The surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist before measuring.
requirements.quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: The RI shall be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

requirements.text: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:.
requirements.quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: A retro-reflective device; (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture. ... It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either: ... or; A retro-reflective device; (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned after about 5 minutes.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: The RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall not be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road

requirements.text: The reference axis of the side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: ... in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps

requirements.text: The reference axis of all other signalling devices shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: ... and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be verified with the system in its neutral state, in the case where an AFS is installed.
requirements.quote: ...and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: The lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics.

requirements.text: The requirement for substantially identical photometric characteristics shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: When stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
requirements.quote: Any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis, shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour;

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The requirements for single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a) shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall have its maximum height above the ground measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall have its minimum height above the ground measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.quote: Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; ...

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: ... (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; ...

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: ... (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; ...

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall not be directly visible towards the front of a vehicle if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle, except that for a red rearmost side-marker lamp direct visibility is permitted.
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall not be directly visible towards the rear of a vehicle if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle, except that for reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings direct visibility is permitted.
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The main-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Main-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Dipped-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall emit white or selective yellow light.
requirements.quote: Front fog lamp: White or selective yellow

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Hazard warning signal: Amber

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall emit amber or red light.
requirements.quote: Emergency stop signal : Amber or red

requirements.text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Rear-end collision alert signal: Amber

requirements.text: The rear registration plate lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Rear registration plate lamp: White

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Front position lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear fog lamp: Red

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall emit white light in front and red light at the rear, or amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: Parking lamp: White in front, red at the rear, amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall emit amber light, except that the rearmost side-marker lamp may be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Side-marker lamp: Amber; however the rearmost side- marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall emit white light in front and red light at the rear.
requirements.quote: End-outline marker lamp: White in front, red at the rear

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Daytime running lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, triangular: Red

requirements.text: The front retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit light identical to the incident light.
requirements.quote: Front retro-reflector, non- triangular: Identical to incident light8

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit amber light, except that the rearmost side retro-reflector may be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.
requirements.quote: Side retro-reflector, non- triangular: Amber; however the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.

requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Cornering lamp: White

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit white light to the front and white or yellow light to the side.
requirements.quote: Conspicuity marking: White to the front; White or yellow to the side;

requirements.text: The rear conspicuity marking shall emit red or yellow light.
requirements.quote: Red or yellow to the rear.

requirements.text: The rear lamp system shall have a number of lamps equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system and the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system and additional lamps for the above functions are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component;

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system and the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on a fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component (with the exception of direction indicator lamps), the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on a fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component (with the exception of direction indicator lamps), the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on a fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component (including direction indicator lamps), the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on a fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component (including direction indicator lamps) and additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: This does not apply where, to fulfil or complete the geometric visibility angle, additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, photometric and colorimetric requirements applicable to the direction indicator lamps installed on the movable component.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: When dipped-beam headlamps or front fog lamps are installed on a movable component, the requirement that the lamp returns to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer is considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps relative to its support measured after each operation differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: When a dipped-beam headlamp or front fog lamp is installed on a movable component and the limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1 is exceeded by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1 shall be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: When the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of additional lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by a movable component, the additional lamps shall be switched ON.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component

requirements.text: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: or 5.21.2. A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components

requirements.text: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control shall respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.quote: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
